function.description: Retrieves a list of projects that Adriel is currently involved with, including project names and the roles assigned. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_status.description: Filter projects by their current status.

function.description: Retrieve the list of technologies that Adriel is currently using or has experience with, including programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
